svg.title: Again architecture: real retrieval, checked applicability, visible evidence
svg.desc: A browser sends JSON to a FastAPI cloud host. Genuine Moss queries an immutable seven-incident seed index and an isolated visitor index. A policy checks only retrieved records. It returns one next step or clarification with evidence and actual status. Secrets remain server-side; teaching expires.
svg.text: AGAIN / SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE
Remember the attempt. Check the conditions.
Browser
Error + current stage + conditions / teach / forget
Memory off: no retrieval. Input leaves the browser.
HTTPS JSON / public cloud deployment
APPLICATION HOST / FASTAPI / PORT 7860
Deployment readiness checked separately
FastAPI: validation, session ownership, serialized native work
Opaque HttpOnly cookie / bounded input and queue / server-side credentials
Ready only after genuine indexing and a successful warm query. No command execution.
Seed working set
7 immutable sanitized real incidents
Genuine Moss / moss-minilm / text query
Readable excerpts; no full private reports
Visitor working set
User-reported outcomes / ephemeral RAM
Moss visitor_id filter + ownership post-check
5 additions per visitor / 1-hour inactivity expiry
Applicability policy over returned IDs
Stage + required facts + contradictions; ask when evidence is incomplete
Recorded status stays intact. Visitor outcomes are not independently verified.
One next step or clarification, with evidence
Failed attempts / conditions / actual outcome status / native IDs and scores
Separate observations: cold readiness, retrieval including embedding, API, browser round trip
Public demo: use sample text. Self-hosting runs the app on your own host.
Moss startup may authenticate or download models. No offline guarantee, generative LLM, or cloud index upload.
